Du begeisterst dich für Datenanalyse und möchtest deine Fähigkeiten in einem dynamischen, praxisnahen Umfeld einsetzen? Dann werde Teil unseres Teams als Business Analytics Intern und unterstütze uns dabei, datenbasierte Entscheidungen zu treffen und unsere Geschäftsprozesse weiterzuentwickeln.

Außerdem arbeitest du an Energiesimulationen und entwickelst gemeinsam mit unserem Team Python-basierte Tools weiter – beispielsweise für die Simulation von Batteriespeichern oder die Bewertung innovativer Energieversorgungslösungen.

Das Praktikum bietet dir umfassende praktische Erfahrungen an der Schnittstelle von Analytics und Energiewirtschaft. Du erhältst Einblicke in ein schnelllebiges Umfeld und hast die Möglichkeit, im Anschluss in eine Werkstudent:innenrolle zu wechseln.

Wenn du Lust hast, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, datenbasierte Lösungen zu entwickeln und die Energiewende aktiv mitzugestalten, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung!

Das Team

Du wirst Teil des Commercial-Teams und unterstützt unsere Go-to-Market-Aktivitäten mit Potenzialanalysen, Energiesimulationen und kommerziellen Auswertungen. Dabei arbeitest du an der Schnittstelle von Energiewirtschaft, Datenanalyse und Vertrieb und hilfst uns, das wirtschaftliche Potenzial von Energieanlagen und innovativen Versorgungslösungen zu bewerten.

Deine Projekte

Profitabilitätsanalysen und Energiedatenmodellierung

  • Du führst Wirtschaftlichkeitsberechnungen für Industriekund:innen durch, bereitest Energiedaten auf und entwickelst Modelle zur Bewertung verschiedener Energieversorgungslösungen.

Workflow-Automatisierung und Prozessoptimierung

  • Du identifizierst wiederkehrende Abläufe und entwickelst datenbasierte Automatisierungslösungen, die unsere internen Prozesse effizienter und skalierbarer machen.

Energiesimulationen und Batteriesteuerung

  • Du nutzt Python-basierte Simulationen für energiewirtschaftliche Anwendungsfälle und entwickelst sie weiter – beispielsweise zur intelligenten Steuerung von Batteriespeichern oder zur Bewertung innovativer Versorgungslösungen.

Datenanalyse und Visualisierung

  • Du analysierst Energie-, Preis- und kommerzielle Daten, identifizierst relevante Zusammenhänge und bereitest deine Erkenntnisse in aussagekräftigen Visualisierungen für Fallstudien, die Website, Vertriebsaktivitäten und interne Stakeholder auf.

Deine Verantwortlichkeiten

  • Datenanalyse und Wirtschaftlichkeitsberechnungen: Du analysierst umfangreiche Energie- und Preisdaten unserer Kund:innen und führst mithilfe unserer Simulationstools detaillierte Wirtschaftlichkeitsberechnungen für verschiedene Energieversorgungslösungen durch.

  • Prozessautomatisierung und Projektarbeit: Du setzt eigenständig Projekte zur Automatisierung und Optimierung von Daten- und Analyseprozessen um. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit interdisziplinären Teams an konkreten Kunden- und Produktanwendungen zusammen.

  • Recherche und Weiterentwicklung: Du recherchierst wissenschaftliche Publikationen sowie neue regulatorische Entwicklungen in den Bereichen Energie und Nachhaltigkeit und prüfst deren Relevanz für unsere Projekte. Gleichzeitig entwickelst du deine Kenntnisse in Data Science, Prozessautomatisierung und Softwareentwicklung kontinuierlich weiter.

The Protocol Security team helps prevent vulnerabilities from reaching Ethereum mainnet.

We work across the execution layer, consensus layer, networking, specifications, testing, and client implementations to identify security issues before they become production incidents. The Mission

OroraTech is a global intelligence-as-a-service company leveraging thermal data from space. As we continue to grow, expand our activities, and develop our organization, the effective execution of our most important company priorities becomes increasingly critical.

We are looking for a highly structured and proactive Chief of Staff to work closely with our CEO and support the execution of selected strategic and cross-functional initiatives.

You will help translate company priorities into clear projects, responsibilities, and next steps. You will independently own assigned projects end-to-end, prepare strategic decisions, and coordinate initiatives involving different functions and senior stakeholders. You will act as a trusted thought partner to the CEO while working closely with the Executive Team and leaders across OroraTech. You will report directly to the CEO.


What you’ll be doing

This is the first Chief of Staff role at OroraTech. The areas below are where we expect you to start. Which of them matter most, and what else belongs in the role, is something you and the CEO will shape together over your first months.
column4:
Company Priorities

  • Own selected company-level initiatives from initial scoping through to a delivered result.
  • Turn broad priorities into a plan with clear owners, milestones, and a defined outcome, then bring the right people from across the company together to deliver it.
  • Do the thinking yourself where it matters: structure the problem, run the analysis, and form a view.
  • Spot the risks and dependencies others are not tracking, and come to the CEO with a recommendation rather than an open question.
  • Stay with an initiative after the decision is made, through the part where momentum sometimes fades.
  • Establish clear follow-up mechanisms and ensure that agreed actions and decisions are implemented.


Mission control: Strategy and operating cadence

  • Support the company’s strategic planning cycle and coordinate the OKR process end to end.
  • Prepare and facilitate Executive meetings, leadership reviews, and strategy sessions: agenda, pre-reads, and decisions recorded with an owner.
  • Maintain a clear view of what the company has committed to and where each commitment stands.


Executive communication and external stakeholders

  • Prepare board materials, investor updates, and decision papers for the CEO and Executive Team, drawing input from relevant stakeholders.
  • Prepare with the CEO ahead of board meetings, partnership discussions, and external engagements, and make sure the follow-ups are picked up.
  • Support investor relations and board processes as they arise.
  •  Contribute to selected initiatives in governmental and regulated markets, working with the internal experts who own the content.

  • Take ownership of urgent and important special projects that do not clearly sit within one function.

Required

  • Experience in strategy, business operations, management consulting, corporate development, venture capital, a founder’s office, or a comparable role.

  • Excellent communication skills in English.

Preferred

  • Experience in a fast-growing technology company, scale-up, or similarly dynamic environment.

Your Impact

We're strong at landing new customers. Now we need to get excellent at growing them.

Expanding within the customer base is one of Tacto's biggest growth levers, and we're building it out for the long term. Most mature B2B companies generate 50%+ of their revenue from existing customers - we want to capture more of that potential, and we're strengthening the team to get there. As Account Manager, you'll be a driving force behind our expansion motion: identifying and closing upsells, cross-sells, and strategic price increases across our customer base, and helping build and sharpen the playbook as we scale it. You'll work between Sales, Customer Value, and Product, spotting growth opportunities and turning them into revenue. This is your chance to build and grow a crucial commercial function at one of Europe's fastest growing industrial AI companies.

Your Tasks

  • Own deals end-to-end: Identify opportunities, build business cases, run negotiations, close deals. Manage contracts and pricing logic.

  • Master account intelligence: Read customer dynamics, map stakeholders, understand politics. Know when to drive expansion yourself vs. when to bring in AEs or Customer Value. Identify perfect timing for upsells.

  • Coordinate across functions: Coordinate with Sales (pipeline), Customer Success (value-delivery), Product (what to sell), and Finance (forecasting) to drive expansion deals

  • Own forecasting and planning: Build accurate expansion forecasts. Coordinate deal timelines. Keep the business informed and on track.

  • Translate roadmap into revenue: Work with Product and Marketing to turn new modules into concrete expansion conversations with the right customers at the right time.

  • Help building the function as it scales: Turn what you learn into reusable process, qualification criteria, pricing guardrails, forecasting templates, rules of engagement with Sales and Customer Value. Where the playbook doesn't exist yet, you help writing it

Your Profile

We're looking for someone who can build, close, and scale. Here's what typically works:

  • 2-4 years in high-performance environments: A proven track record of hitting, and significantly overachieving, quarterly or yearly commercial targets, in account management, sales, or a customer success role with a real commercial component.

  • Proven commercial track record in B2B SaaS companies.

  • Extremely smart and driven – you connect dots quickly, learn fast, and push hard to win

  • Excellent stakeholder management – you navigate complex organizations, build relationships with senior buyers (Heads of Procurement, C-Level), and align internal teams

  • Negotiation toughness – you hold your ground in price discussions without burning bridges

  • Process-oriented – you own details: contracts, terms, renewal dates, forecasting

  • Genuine interest in industrial procurement – you want to understand how manufacturing companies work and speak their language

  • Native German + fluent English

Why This Role is Awesome

This is the first dedicated Account Manager seat at Tacto. Some first structures exist, but most of the function is still yours to build: the quota model, the rules of engagement with Sales and Customer Value, the process itself. Get this right, and expansion becomes Tacto's biggest new revenue lever within two to three years, that's the scale of upside on the table. Do it well for the first 12 to 18 months, and you define your next step: a bigger book of accounts, leading the function as it grows into a full team, or a move into Sales or Customer Value leadership.

What This Role Is - and Isn't

  • This is not customer support with a sales quota bolted on. You'll be measured on revenue, not on being liked, and some weeks that means pushing a commercial conversation the customer wasn't asking for.

  • This is not a mature, handed-to-you playbook. You'll build your own pipeline, your own forecast discipline, and parts of the process itself.

  • Prove you can turn module adoption into signed expansion revenue, and we'll back you owning a bigger book, leading the function, or moving into Sales or CV leadership next.

Why Tacto

  • A truly AI-native organization, with every resource you could dream of. All the leading AI tools and custom agents at your fingertips, plus dedicated people who keep us at the frontier.

  • High bar, high speed, genuinely fun. You'll be surrounded by extremely smart and ambitious people who set the bar high and push you to get better every week. Intense, fast, and the opposite of boring.

  • A front-row seat in the European startup ecosystem. Weekly exposure to leading founders and operators through internal and external events (Lunch &

The knowledge that holds manufacturing together - part costs, suppliers, materials - is scattered across systems and people. Manufacturing forms Europe's economic backbone, driving a fourth of Europe's GDP and providing over 30% of jobs. These hidden champions and global market leaders manufacture the physical world around us, from the machines that build our cities to the medical devices that save lives.

Europe's strength lies in its deep industrial knowledge through generations of engineering. Manufacturing worldwide runs on European machines and software. But that heritage is only an advantage if we leverage it in the age of AI.

Tacto builds the AI that connects Atoms and Bits, empowering our Industrial Base to Stay Stronger and building a lighthouse for European tech.

Odin is building the investment infrastructure for the future of private markets.
We believe capital is one of the most powerful tools for shaping the world - and more people should be putting it to work. Our mission is to make it radically easier to raise and deploy capital, so that anyone, anywhere, can back the companies and ideas they believe in.

Our first product is a full-stack platform for launching and running private investment firms - think Shopify for VC and PE. We handle all the infrastructure: from legals and investor onboarding to KYC/AML, payments, tax, reporting, and exits.

This role is highly hands-on and combines functional safety engineering with real-world safety controller programming and software integration. You will collaborate closely with robotics software (navigation/perception/control), electrical and mechanical engineering, and field operations to deliver safety solutions that scale across platforms and deployments.

  • Day-to-day development, commissioning, troubleshooting, and versioned configuration management of SICK Safety Designer projects.

  • Support for certifications, audits, and customer/site acceptance related to machinery safety and mobile robot standards (e.g., ISO 3691-4, ISO 13849).

Safety concept, risk assessment, and requirements

  • Lead and continuously maintain risk assessments for our vehicles and operating modes (e.g., autonomous, manual, service/maintenance) and derive safety requirements and safety functions.

  • Translate safety requirements into an implementable safety concept and safety controller design, including safety I/O definitions, sensor coverage strategy, and safe-state behavior.

  • Define required Performance Levels (PLr) / SIL targets for safety functions and maintain traceability from hazards → safety requirements → implementation → verification evidence.

SICK safety controller programming (SICK Safety Designer)

  • Design, implement, and maintain safety logic in SICK safety controllers using SICK Safety Designer, including diagnostics and safe-state handling.

  • Commission and troubleshoot safety systems on real robots: wiring verification, signal integrity, scanner/encoder configuration, safety I/O checks, and fault analysis.

  • Build a maintainable configuration strategy across product variants: reusable modules, clear naming conventions, version control, and release/deployment procedures for safety configurations.

  • Implement and validate common AMR/AGV safety behaviors such as emergency stop, protective stop, speed reduction, safe direction, safe speed monitoring, and field set switching (as applicable to the platform).

  • Work with robotics software engineers to pinpoint root causes across the stack (safety controller, sensors, network, application logic) and drive issues to resolution.

Meet DeepL

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.

Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.

What sets us apart

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.

How you will contribute to DeepL's success

  • Lead, inspire, and set the strategic vision for the Enterprise Sales team in Germany and contribute to the broader DeepL sales organisation

  • Build and grow a high-performing team through thoughtful hiring, structured onboarding, ongoing coaching, and professional development of Account Executives

  • Be the driving force behind scaling the team and the business — creating the processes, playbooks, and culture that enable sustainable, long-term growth

  • Own your team's performance targets and cultivate an environment where every AE can do their best work

  • Collaborate closely with Sales Development, Solution Consulting, Customer Success, Product, and Marketing to align priorities and maximize collective impact

  • Develop and maintain a deep understanding of DeepL's product and competitive landscape to support your team with confidence

  • Build, track, and analyse sales pipelines and buying trends, using insights to continuously improve how we work

  • Report predictably and accurately to senior leadership on progress and challenges, including regular forecasting

  • Establish scalable policies and processes that set the team — and DeepL's Enterprise revenue — up for success

  • Roll up your sleeves when it matters: you lead by example and show up for your team and customers

About AIOS

AIOS is building the world’s first full-stack AI doctor.
We’re at $350M ARR, growing from $10M/yr 12 months ago. We’re the world’s fastest growing AI doctor.
We’re faithfully serving >
column2:
150k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy, our main UK brand. We’re profitable.
Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses:

  1. The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history.

  2. The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders.

Our master plan:

  • Step 0 → $100M/yr by end of 2025: We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market.

  • Step 1 → $1B ARR by end of 2026: Over the last 12 months we’ve grown from 3k to 150k UK active GLP-1 patients. We’ll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR.

  • Step 2 → $10B ARR by end of 2028: Blitzscale Europe. We’ll be Europe’s largest GLP-1 provider.

  • Step 3 → $100B/yr by end of 2031: Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We’ll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe.

  • Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035: With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication.

In so doing, we’ll become the world’s first trillion-dollar healthcare company.
We’re a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

You can read more about working with us here:Working at AIOS

Being a Product Designer at AIOS

We are building a world-class team.

You’ll be taking on a senior, high-ownership role in product design at Aios Medical. We have multiple roles in the team across our clinical software and customer facing mobile app.

You’ll be stepping into a product that has grown fast and needs stronger design leadership, judgment, and structure.

Some of this work is visible and polished. Some of it is messy and internal. You’ll own projects end-to-end. That means taking loosely defined problems, talking to the right people, understanding workflows and constraints, and shipping solutions you can stand behind. We’re looking for someone who can run with a problem independently and be trusted to get it over the line.

The work often sits at the intersection of user needs, business goals, and real constraints. You might be working with engineers on a customer app flow, untangling a complex internal workflow that’s slowing teams down, reviewing CX tickets to understand where users are breaking, or defending a design decision.

You’ll report directly to our Head of Product Design (Ryan Wu) and work closely with our Head of Product (Ben Dowdle). You’ll also work alongside the rest of our Product and Design org, as well as our engineering and CX teams. You’ll be superb at collaborating and moving fast.

This is a full-time, remote role. We’re async-friendly and flexible with hours, but overlap with European and US time zones is expected.

Key responsibilities

  • Design ownership: You take ownership of design work across products and run projects independently, from problem definition to shipped solution.

  • Customer apps: You design and improve customer-facing web and mobile app experiences. Mobile app work is a major focus area.

  • Internal tools &
column3:
workflows: You work on internal products used by clinical, ops, enrolment, and CX teams, focusing on workflow, usability, and efficiency.

  • Complex problem solving: You work on products with real commercial and regulatory constraints. You understand that not everything can be changed freely.

  • Business &
column4:
user understanding: You start from the business problem and the user need. You can clearly explain what problem you were solving and why.

  • End-to-end project ownership: You lead projects independently, including discovery, talking to users or internal teams, defining the solution, and shipping it.

  • Clear communication: You can articulate your thinking, defend decisions, and hold your ground in discussions with strong opinions.

  • Hands-on leadership: You’re comfortable being senior, helping shape how design works, and supporting other designers as the team grows, without stepping away from hands-on work.

    • Need to have

    Experience: You’ve spent 3+ years designing digital products across web or mobile, including customer-facing mobile apps or internal tooling. What matters is that you’ve designed real products used by real people.

    Robust Portfolio: Your portfolio shows real product work that shows off your design taste. We want to see the problem, the rules you had to work within, and the impact of your decisions - including polished screens of the output.

    Ownership: You take loosely defined problems and run with them. You figure out what needs to be done, who to talk to, and how to move a project from idea to shipped solution. You don’t need constant direction, and you don’t get stuck in endless exploration.

    Craft: You care about clarity and usability more than surface-level polish. You can work within fixed requirements, technical limitations, and existing systems, and still make meaningful improvements.

    Clear thinking &
column5:
communication: You can clearly explain what problem you were solving, why certain decisions were made, and what tradeoffs were involved. You’re comfortable defending your work and navigating discussions with strong opinions.

Nice to have

Formal or equivalent design training: You’ve studied design, computer science, or a related field - or you’ve built the same depth of thinking through real product work.

Working in regulated and complex products: You don’t need experience in healthcare specifically. What matters is that you’ve worked on products where design decisions are shaped by regulation, compliance, legal requirements, or strong business rules. You understand that some copy, flows, or elements can’t simply be removed or redesigned, and that good design often means improving clarity and usability within those realities

Design that gets built: You’re comfortable working with engineers and thinking through implementation details. You understand how design decisions show up in real code and systems.

Our cultural standards

We aim to make this your life’s work. This should be the most challenging, most rewarding role of your life. Accordingly, these are the core cultural standards to which we hold ourselves &
column6:
our team-members:

  1. Belief in the mission: We will have served 100 million patients by the end of 2035 and we transform the life of most patients who join. We have a lot of work to do. We are obsessed with our patients and are dedicated to the mission.

  2. Unwavering integrity: We are at the frontier, so we often live in ambiguity with no trodden path. When we can’t look to others for guidance, we must maintain impeccable ethics and unwavering integrity.

  3. Only the paranoid survive: Bad sh*t is coming. By joining us, you’re choosing to sail straight towards the storms with unhesitating conviction. However much we’ve already done, however far we’ve already come — it’s still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

  4. If we’re average we fail: We are only interested in “insanely great”, a focus on the quality of our execution that in everyday life would be considered pathological. We have a dedication to excellence and reject incompetence.

  5. Commitment to candor: That which can be destroyed by the truth should be. You get full transparency from the company and the company expects full transparency from you. We never say anything about someone that we wouldn’t say to them directly. We give feedback with love and do not need to protect people from fleeting physical sensations.

  6. A maniacal sense of urgency: We execute at an intensity that most people think is impossible. Speed is critical and we need things done yesterday. We all work very hard and in such a competitive world there really is no other way to win.

  7. Enduring frugality: We are frugal. We hate being wasteful and we are anti-luxury. A culture of cheapness keeps us young. We spend our cash wisely &

Strom lässt sich nicht auf Halde legen. Erzeugung und Verbrauch müssen sich in jeder Sekunde ausgleichen, sonst kippt die Netzfrequenz. Das ist keine Haltung, das ist Physik.
Aus dieser Physik entsteht ein Markt, der in 15-Minuten-Scheiben handelt und keine Rücksicht nimmt. Genau dort läuft unsere Software.

Wir bewirtschaften heute 350 MWp Solar, 100 MWp Wind, 100 MWh Speicher, 12 MW Wasserstoff und über 40 HPC-Ladepunkte. Jede dieser Anlagen liefert Zeitreihen. Aus Zeitreihen werden Prognosen, aus Prognosen Fahrpläne, aus Fahrplänen Gebote an der Börse. Wenn ein Glied dieser Kette zwanzig Minuten zu spät ist, kostet das Geld. Nicht Story Points. Geld.

Wir haben die Plattform in wenigen Jahren von null auf 850 GWh gebracht. An einigen Stellen haben wir dabei bewusst pragmatisch gebaut, weil am Markt zu sein wichtiger war als sauber zu sein. Das war richtig.

Heute ist es das nicht mehr. Dieselben Abkürzungen, die uns schnell gemacht haben, bremsen uns inzwischen. Tabellen, die für Millionen Zeilen gedacht waren, halten Milliarden. Prozessketten, die früher jemand morgens von Hand angestoßen hat, laufen rund um die Uhr und dürfen nicht mehr ausfallen.
Wir suchen niemanden, der das verwaltet. Wir suchen jemanden, der es neu baut, während es läuft.
• Du entscheidest, wie unsere Systeme geschnitten sind. Nicht in einem Gremium, sondern indem Du den Vorschlag machst, ihn verteidigst und ihn anschließend umsetzt. Wer entscheidet, baut mit.

• PostgreSQL und TimescaleDB, Fahrpläne, Messwerte, Marktdaten. Schema, Partitionierung, Aggregation, Query-Pläne. Wenn eine Abfrage acht Sekunden braucht, ist das für uns ein Fehler und kein Feature.
• Prognose, Optimierung, Fahrplanübermittlung. Retry, Idempotenz, Alerting. Der Maßstab ist simpel: Was nachts schiefgeht, darf morgens niemand von Hand nacharbeiten müssen.

• Anlagen anbinden. PV, Speicher, Wasserstoff, Ladeinfrastruktur. ModbusTCP, REST, SFTP. Du telefonierst dabei direkt mit den Technikern beim Kunden und suchst den Fehler gemeinsam, statt ein Ticket zu schreiben.

• Am Monatsende wird aus denselben Zeitreihen Geld. Marktprämie, PPA- und Speichervergütung, Umlagen, Ladevorgänge, THG-Quoten. Netzbetreiber liefern Messwerte nach, korrigieren sie und schicken ein Jahr später erneut. Deine Läufe müssen das aushalten und beim zweiten Durchlauf dasselbe Ergebnis liefern wie beim ersten.
• PHP mit Laravel, React, PostgreSQL/TimescaleDB, Python. Tests, CI/CD und Monitoring gehören zur Umsetzung und nicht zu dem, was man danach noch macht.
• Wir arbeiten mit Claude und vergleichbaren Werkzeugen produktiv, nicht als Demo. Du weißt aus eigener Erfahrung, wo sie tragen und wo sie Unsinn produzieren, und Du gibst das ins Team weiter.

Die Zeitreihe, die um 14:30 den Fahrplan bestimmt, bestimmt am Monatsende, was der Kunde ausgezahlt bekommt. Wenn beide Wege zu unterschiedlichen Zahlen kommen, ist das kein Monitoring-Thema mehr. Das findet dann der Wirtschaftsprüfer.

Deshalb liegen bei dieser Rolle beide Seiten in einer Hand. Vorne zählt Geschwindigkeit, hinten Reproduzierbarkeit: Ein Abrechnungslauf muss nach einem Jahr mit korrigierten Netzbetreiberdaten erneut startbar sein und nachvollziehbar erklären, warum sich das Ergebnis geändert hat. Versionierte Tarif- und Vergütungslogik, idempotente Wiederholungsläufe, saubere Zuordnung über MaLo-IDs. Wer das trennt, baut zwei Wahrheiten.
Nach 90 Tagen hast Du einen strukturellen Engpass beseitigt, und man kann es messen.

Nach zwölf Monaten gehen neue Anlagen ohne Sonderlösung produktiv, die zeitkritischen Ketten und die Abrechnungsläufe laufen ohne Handarbeit, und die Entwickler um Dich herum sind besser geworden. Der letzte Punkt zählt genauso wie die beiden davor.
Wir haben keine Anforderung an Deinen Abschluss. Wir haben eine an Deinen Nachweis.

• Du hast mindestens ein System durch einen Skalierungssprung getragen und warst dabei derjenige, der die Architekturentscheidung getroffen hat. Fünf Jahre Berufserfahrung ist unsere Faustregel dafür, keine Bedingung. Wer es in drei geschafft hat, ist uns genauso recht.

• Du hast eine Prozesskette gebaut, die nachts ohne Dich läuft. Und Du hast erlebt, was passiert, wenn sie es nicht tut.

• Git, Docker, CI/CD, automatisierte Tests, Observability. Handwerk, kein Projekt.

ait-thermal-qualification-intern-munich-498772,The Exploration Company,AIT Thermal & Qualification Intern,"

Here at The Exploration Company, we are developing, producing, and operating Nyx, a modular and reusable space orbital vehicle that can eventually be refuelled in orbit and that can carry cargo - and potentially humans in the longer run.

Your mission:

Here at the The Exploration Company we are developing, producing, and operating Nyx, a modular and reusable space orbital vehicle that can eventually be refueled in orbit, and which carries cargo - and potentially humans in the longer run.

We want you as a talented AIT intern to help us in our mission by qualifying thermo-mechanical process for the Flight Model 1 and for the preparation of the integration of the flight model.

You will be successful in this role if you are able to help us:

  • Defining qualification plan

  • Supporting the Thermal Control System setup preparation and test

  • Defining the integration and test sequence

  • Procuring parts for the test

  • Procedures writing

Tasks:

Your role will be continuously evolving, but day to day your duties will include:

  • You will support the qualification of several processes (e.g. bonding and calibration of sensors, validation of foam fixation withing the Capsule)

  • You will support in testing the qualification either internally or externally, included the coordination with all stakeholders

  • You will prepare the test plan and the procedures, and also the coupons for testing

  • You will support the Active Thermal Control System integration and test

  • You will be supporting the procurement of tools needed

  • You will be supporting the writing of the procedures detailing the qualification, Integration and test operations

  • You will take care of improving the processes and procedure with the lessons learnt of the previous operations

  • You may have to support the team in other factory setup as we are a growing company, the perimeter can evolve along the mission.

What we would love to see from you:

  • Studying for an Engineering degree (Master) in mechanical science or equivalent

  • Experience with CAD software preferably with Siemens NX

  • Past experience with thermal setup will be a plus

  • Expierence in procedure writing with a MES and in inventory management with an ERP

  • Past experience in cleanroom environment will be a plus

  • Experience with fluidic/harness routing in Siemens NX a strong plus

  • Willingness to contribute to build and support a new team

  • Independent, organized and rigorous

  • Hands-on approach

  • Inventive and problem solver

  • Team spirit

Skills and Behaviours

  • Good organizing and prioritization of tasks

  • Positive and flexible attitude to get the job done

  • Ability to communicate at all levels of the business

  • Demonstrates behaviors consistent with The Exploration Company’s core values of Commitment, Innovation, Trust, Quality, and Teamwork

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?

Orbem uses AI to industrialize MRI, delivering non-invasive insight into everything from fruits to eggs to the human body. Help us see what's possible. Join us.

Your Role

You will build Orbem's legal and compliance function largely from the ground up, at a pivotal moment. This is a role for a hands-on legal counsel who wants to build a function, not just run one — someone comfortable with ambiguity, who makes pragmatic, risk-balanced calls with incomplete information, and does the substantive legal work themselves while orchestrating a lean stack of external counsel.

A central part of the role is building Orbem's compliance function: a cross-functional, integrated approach to knowing and managing our risks — across intellectual property, product compliance, information security, data protection, and regulatory readiness. Deine Rolle

Die meisten Schülerjobs zeigen dir wenig: Regale einräumen, Spülmaschine, immer derselbe Handgriff.

Wir sind ein Beratungsunternehmen mit fast 15 Millionen Euro Umsatz, über 100 Mitarbeitern und dem Anspruch, Steuerberatung grundlegend zu modernisieren. Und auch als Schüler im Minijob bist du Teil davon — nicht am Rand, sondern mittendrin.

Du bist Schüler und suchst einen Nebenjob, der mehr ist als Taschengeld: Du packst mit an, damit der Laden läuft — in einem Umfeld, das digital arbeitet, in moderne Technik investiert und in dem du Dinge siehst und lernst, die dir in keinem anderen Schülerjob begegnen.

Du unterstützt unser Team in Aalen bei Technik, Digitalisierung und Organisation. Wenn beide Seiten überzeugt sind, kann daraus mehr werden — ein Praktikum, eine Ausbildung oder ein duales Studium.

Deine Verantwortung

Technik &
column2:
Arbeitsplätze

  • Du richtest Arbeitsplätze ein — Monitore, Laptops, Docking Stations — damit neue Kollegen am ersten Tag loslegen können.

  • Du verwaltest und inventarisierst unsere Hardware und behältst den Überblick, welches Gerät wo im Einsatz ist.

Digitalisierung

  • Du scannst Unterlagen ein und legst sie sauber in der digitalen Ablage ab.

  • Du hilfst mit, Papierprozesse abzulösen — jeder Ordner, den du digitalisierst, verschwindet dauerhaft aus dem Büro.

Organisation im Büro

  • Du bearbeitest die Post, kümmerst dich um Büromaterial und bereitest Meetingräume vor.

  • Je nach Interesse bekommst du Einblicke in die Finanzbuchführung und in interne Projekte.

Das bringst du mit

Erfahrung &
column3:
Track Record

  • Du bist Schüler — ob Realschule, Gymnasium oder Berufsschule ist uns weniger wichtig als deine Einstellung.

  • Berufserfahrung brauchst du keine. Was zählt: Du bist zuverlässig, pünktlich und hältst, was du zusagst.

  • Auch wenn du noch nie in einem Büro gearbeitet hast, bist du ausdrücklich eingeladen — wir bewerten am Beitrag, nicht am Etikett. Wer anpackt und mitdenkt, passt zu uns.

Skills &
column4:
Arbeitsweise

  • Du gehst sorgfältig mit Technik und Unterlagen um.

  • Du arbeitest selbstständig — wenn etwas unklar ist, fragst du, statt zu warten.

Mindset &
column5:
Persönlichkeit

  • Du hast Eigeninitiative: Du siehst, was zu tun ist, und machst es.

  • Du bist neugierig darauf, wie ein digital arbeitendes Unternehmen von innen funktioniert.

Was du bei uns nicht finden wirst

  • Kein Abstell-Job am Rand. Auch als Schüler im Minijob bist du Teil des Teams — mit echten Aufgaben, die das Unternehmen braucht.

  • Kein „wir geben dir Arbeit, wenn jemand frei ist, dich anzuleiten“-Setup. Du bekommst verbindliche Aufgabenpakete mit klarem Anleiter, nicht nur Lückenfüllung.

  • Kein „irgendwann darfst du mal eigenständig arbeiten“. Bei uns gilt von Tag eins: Du machst, du trägst, du wirst korrigiert, wenn nötig — aber du wartest nicht.

  • Kein verstaubtes Büro mit Papierbergen und Faxgerät. Wir investieren in moderne Technik und digitale Prozesse — du arbeitest mit Geräten und Tools, die dir in keinem anderen Schülerjob begegnen.

FAQ

1. Was ist Vogel — und wo arbeitet ihr?

Vogel ist eine der führenden Mittelstandsberatungen Deutschlands — Familienunternehmen seit 1959, aus Aalen — und baut daraus die führende Beratungsplattform für den Mittelstand. Wir wachsen an mehreren Standorten: in Aalen/Ostwürttemberg als gewachsenem Stammsitz und in München als neuem Hub. An beiden suchen wir quer durch die Funktionen — von Steuerberatung über Beratung bis zu den strategischen Teams, die die Plattform bauen.

2. Wie sind die Gehaltsbänder zu verstehen?

Bewusst breit — und an jeder Stelle ausgewiesen. Wir differenzieren nach Track Record und Marktwert, nicht nach Abschluss: knappe, stark gefragte Profile am oberen Ende, weniger knappe am unteren. Wir kalibrieren ausschließlich am Markt — zwei Menschen mit ähnlicher Erfahrung können bei uns unterschiedlich verdienen.

3. Wie viel — und wie — wird bei Vogel gearbeitet?

Gemessen wird an dem, was du bewegst, nicht an Stunden. Ehrlich ist aber auch: Wer 9-to-5 sucht, ist bei uns nicht die erste Adresse. Wir suchen Menschen, die aus eigenem Antrieb intensiv arbeiten, weil die Aufgaben es wert sind. Wie du deine Zeit verteilst, ist weitgehend deine Sache. Was wir teilen: Wir arbeiten präsent zusammen — Kultur, Sparring und die besten Ideen entstehen in der täglichen Nähe. Wir sind keine Remote-Company und haben keine großen Home-Office-Policies

Schlank, schnell, transparent — und nach Profil gestaffelt. Für Einstiegsrollen (Praktikum, Werkstudium, Berufseinstieg) genügen in der Regel zwei Gespräche und eine kurze Arbeitsprobe

Quartalsweise an Leistung gekoppelt, qualitativ bewertet. Die Skala steigt mit dem Level: bis 20 % Associate, 27,5 % Manager, 35 % Senior Manager, 42,5 % Director, 50 % VP. Our analysts therefore have a dual mission: they continuously deepen their expertise in business domains and statistical modeling while simultaneously helping build and improve the AI-powered production platform that will define the future of proprietary data.

Vogel ist eine der führenden Mittelstandsberatungen Deutschlands — Familienunternehmen seit 1959, aus Aalen — und baut daraus die führende Beratungsplattform für den Mittelstand. Wir wachsen an mehreren Standorten: in Aalen/Ostwürttemberg als gewachsenem Stammsitz und in München als neuem Hub. An beiden suchen wir quer durch die Funktionen — von Steuerberatung über Beratung bis zu den strategischen Teams, die die Plattform bauen.

Bewusst breit — und an jeder Stelle ausgewiesen. Wir differenzieren nach Track Record und Marktwert, nicht nach Abschluss: knappe, stark gefragte Profile am oberen Ende, weniger knappe am unteren. Gemessen wird an dem, was du bewegst, nicht an Stunden. Ehrlich ist aber auch: Wer 9-to-5 sucht, ist bei uns nicht die erste Adresse. Wir suchen Menschen, die aus eigenem Antrieb intensiv arbeiten, weil die Aufgaben es wert sind. Wie du deine Zeit verteilst, ist weitgehend deine Sache. product-manager-courier-delivery-experience-berlin-471911,Wolt - English,"Product Manager, Courier Delivery Experience","

About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

We seek a Product Manager to join our Courier and Delivery Experience (CDX) team. This role will focus on ensuring world-class courier and consumer delivery experiences while continually evolving the delivery process with a future-oriented mindset. The Courier and Delivery Experience team owns the experiences that elevate every Wolt delivery, from the moment a courier opens the app to every order they accept, all the way to dropping an order off at the customer's doorstep. The team sits at the intersection of a multi-sided marketplace product, real-world operations, and safety, and the work directly moves how reliable Wolt feels to consumers and how satisfied our couriers are when delivering.

You will play a crucial role in shaping the courier experience, ensuring that our couriers feel valued and supported while enhancing the efficiency of deliveries. By blending operational expertise with a deep understanding of courier needs, you will improve the user journey from onboarding couriers to completing deliveries. From designing new features that boost courier satisfaction to refining delivery processes, your work will contribute to key metrics across courier engagement, performance, and satisfaction. You will also be influential in shaping the evolution of the live delivery experience for our courier partners, the merchant courier interaction at pickup and the consumer courier interaction at the doorstep via the Courier app surfaces.

The ideal candidate will have an exceptional track record in product management, with proven success in working with cross-functional teams across engineering, design, product, and operations. You will define the vision and roadmap for courier and delivery experiences across multiple projects. Working in partnership with business stakeholders, you will also collaborate on cross-team initiatives, contributing to the broader business strategy while ensuring a deep understanding of the courier experience.
Join us in shaping the future of delivery, where every delivery is an opportunity for delight and loyalty.
You could come to this role from various backgrounds, but ideally, you bring:
• Several years of experience in product management, specializing in consumer-facing products
• Expertise in developing user-centric products, with the ability to address complex user experience-related challenges.
• Demonstrated expertise in supporting cross-functional teams and fostering operational excellence in fast-paced, high-demand industries.
• Proven track record in building products influencing cross-functional teams, including engineering, data, design, and operations.
• High ownership and collaborative capabilities, making thoughtful decisions, and focusing on product details to ensure execution aligns with the vision.
• Strong ability to define, execute, and measure meaningful OKRs, ensuring alignment with company-wide goals and fostering bottom-up alignment from your team.
• Ability to focus on the bigger picture, creating solutions that benefit couriers, operations, and customer experiences across the organization.
• Excellent stakeholder management skills, able to work effectively with diverse internal teams and external partners, while confidently engaging with leadership in a high-visibility role
The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!

The compensation will be a negotiable combination of monthly pay and DoorDash RSUs. The latter makes it exceptionally easy to be excited about our company growing and doing well, as you'll own a piece of the pie.
Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Data quality is the bottleneck of the AI era. Every Fortune 500 is trying to solve it. We're the team they call.

Soda is the data quality layer for Disney, Ralph Lauren, CBRE, HelloFresh, 2K Games, and Nubank. Our open-source engine, Soda Core, is used by companies like Tesla, Slack, Adyen, Walmart, and JPMC. The category is growing fast because AI doesn't work on bad data, and we're hiring a
column3:
to build the platform that catches data problems before they become business problems.

About Us

Soda's mission is to monitor the world's decisions. We're building the first Data &
column4:
AI performance monitoring platform that spans data collection to automated decision-making. Soda helps customers find, understand, and fix data quality issues by combining automated post-production monitoring with pre-production pipeline data testing.

Soda was founded in 2019 by Maarten (employee #5 at Collibra) and Tom (creator of multiple open-source projects generating hundreds of millions in value). We commercialize through Soda Cloud and we're well-funded, with investors like Point 9 Capital, Hummingbird, Singular, and Eurazeo.

The Role

You'll join our Platform team and own the full path from backend service to production: the Java services that power Soda Cloud
column6:
the AWS/Kubernetes infrastructure they run on. To be clear about the shape of this role: you're a backend engineer first. Most of your time goes into designing and building services. Infrastructure is the part of your craft that lets you own them all the way to production, not a separate job. This is not a DevOps or SRE position. You ship features, and you make sure the platform underneath them scales to billions of datasets.

We're product engineers, not ticket-takers: you'll talk to users, shape solutions with your PM, and ship end-to-end. No hand-offs, no waiting. We also build agentically: AI coding agents are part of how the whole team ships, and the platform you own is a big part of what makes them effective.

What You'll Do

  • Design and build robust backend services and APIs in Java for a multi-tenant SaaS platform. This is where most of your time goes.
  • Ship product features end-to-end and work directly with product and customers on what to build. Your opinion matters here.
  • Improve the reliability, performance, and scalability of the services you own, and carry them all the way to production on our AWS/Kubernetes platform.
  • Keep the team shipping fast: CI/CD pipelines, GitOps workflows, observability. This is the platform work that multiplies everyone else.
  • Improve the systems that make agentic development work: fast CI feedback, reliable dev environments, and the guardrails that let agents ship safely.
  • Drive architectural decisions, from service design to how the platform underneath should evolve.

Hiring Process

  1. CV screen
  2. 20-minute phone screen
  3. First technical interview (45 min)
  4. Second technical interview (60 min)
  5. Culture fit (45 min)

We answer every application, and every candidate hears back within 3–5 days of each step. If it's not a hell yes, it's a no, and we'll tell you quickly and kindly.

Requirements

You Should Have

  • 5+ years building backend software at a product company: you've designed, built, and owned real production services, not just operated them.
  • Strong Java: APIs, async processing, concurrency, performance tuning.
  • Solid SQL in a backend context: schema design, query optimization, migrations in production. We run MySQL and ClickHouse.
  • Architectural judgment: you understand how API and service design choices shape data flow, query patterns, latency, and failure modes at runtime.
  • You run what you build: your services have lived on Kubernetes and AWS (EKS, IAM, networking, RDS, S3) in production, and you're happy owning that layer for the team.
  • CI/CD, GitOps, and infrastructure-as-code: GitHub Actions, ArgoCD/Flux, Terraform or Pulumi, plus solid scripting.
  • Observability as a habit: metrics, logging, tracing (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry), and you actually write tests.
  • Agentic engineering: you ship production code with AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) in the loop, and you know how to direct them well while keeping the quality bar high.
  • Independence: you don't need hand-holding in a distributed, async team across 12+ countries.
  • Fluent English.

Good to Have

  • Multi-tenant SaaS at scale
column7:
high-growth startup experience.
  • Python: our data engineering stack runs on it.
  • Regulated-environment experience (ISO27001, SOC2).
  • Experience building agentic workflows into the product: LLM-powered features, tool-using agents, or AI-driven automation shipped to real users.
  • Data quality, data management, data observability, or ML monitoring industry experience.

    • Benefits

    What We Offer

    • Compensation €85,000-120,000/year + equity.
    • Fully remote (EU-based), with a Belgian office available if you want one.
    • All the tokens you need, across all frontier models.
    • Real ownership, real impact, no micromanagement.
    • A team of senior engineers who ship, across 12+ countries.

    Our Values

    We value freedom with responsibility, transparency, and a growth mindset. We avoid politics, have no tolerance for dishonesty, and value open and direct communication without judgment. We proactively bring up and address potential issues before they become critical, and we overcommunicate frequently. Working at Soda, you will have full autonomy to make impactful product and roadmap decisions.

    ❤️ Why you will love to join Soda

    • Be part of a transformation: data quality is having its moment, and we're at the front of it.
    • Ownership from day one: if you see a bottleneck, you remove it.
    • International culture: colleagues in 12+ countries.
    • Work on your own terms: fully remote, flexible hours.

    😡 What you might not love

    • Rapidly changing priorities: our roadmap can pivot quickly. It's a fast-paced environment with a LOT of work to be done.
    • Flexibility required: you will have to learn new things all the time.

  • Build, launch, and continuously improve Lio’s website in Webflow or Framer

  • Are highly comfortable building and shipping websites in Webflow or Framer

  • Can take a rough idea or Figma concept and turn it into a polished live experience

Wir suchen Dich

Du willst Marketing nicht nur in der Vorlesung hören, sondern wirklich machen?
Du hast Lust, in Zahlen einzutauchen, kreativ zu werden und im Team Kampagnen aufzubauen, die vor allem unsere DACH-Crowd aktivieren? Dann passt du ziemlich gut zu uns.
Bei Invesdor, Europas führender Impact-Investmentplattform, verbinden wir Rendite mit Wirkung. Über unsere Plattform investieren Menschen in Unternehmen, die die Welt ein Stück besser machen wollen – von erneuerbaren Energien bis hin zu MedTech und EdTech.


Deine Aufgaben

Als Werkstudent:in im Marketing bist du mittendrin statt nur dabei. Du arbeitest an Kampagnen, die unsere Projekte sichtbar machen, stärkst unsere Marke im DACH-Raum und begeisterst unsere Crowd mit passendem Content. Von Anfang an bekommst du eigene, klar umrissene Aufgabenbereiche und übernimmst nach und nach kleine Projekte selbst – natürlich mit Rückhalt durch das Team.

  • Verantwortung für Planung, Umsetzung und ein einfaches Reporting – mit Feedback und Sparring aus dem Team

Über Aampere
column2:
>Werde Teil von Aampere, einem Seed-Stage VC-backed Startup, das den europäischen Markt für gebrauchte E-Autos neu definiert. Wir ermöglichen EV-Besitzern einen Verkauf innerhalb von 48 Stunden und geben Händlern in ganz Europa Zugang zu neuen Kundengruppen. Der Markt ist fragmentiert, undurchsichtig und schwer vertrauenswürdig. Wir bauen die Infrastruktur, die das löst, damit mehr E-Autos ein zweites Leben bekommen und der Umstieg auf Elektro wirklich Fahrt aufnimmt.

Und es funktioniert: Jahr für Jahr vervierfachen wir unseren Umsatz und halten bereits über 1% der Wiederverkäufe von E-Autos an Endkunden in Deutschland. Unser Team kommt aus der deutschen Startup-Szene und der Automobilwelt, mit Erfahrung bei Autarc, Limehome, Cardino, Wemolo, Alasco, Porsche, Mercedes und KPMG.

Ein Logenplatz dafür, wie ein Startup gebaut und geführt wird. Du bist die rechte Hand unseres Chief of Staff, Benni, der Mitarbeiter Nummer eins bei einem YC-backed Startup war und vor Aampere bei mehreren Top-Tier-VC-Startups gearbeitet hat. Du sitzt dort, wo das Unternehmen gesteuert wird, arbeitest über alle Funktionen hinweg und übernimmst echte Verantwortung ab der ersten Woche. Wenn du lernen willst, wie man ein Startup von innen betreibt, von People über GTM und Finance bis Ops, gibt es kaum bessere Plätze.


Deine Mission
column3: >Bau die Organisation mit uns, nicht für uns.
column4:
> Wir verantworten die People-Funktion und skalieren gerade unseren Headcount stark, während wir die Strukturen bauen, die die nächste Welle an Hires trägt. Du sitzt mitten in diesem Aufbau und ownst echte Teile davon, statt sie von der Seite zu beobachten.
Sitz dort, wo gesteuert wird. Die Chief-of-Staff-Rolle lebt zwischen den OKRs der Gründer und den Ownern, die sie liefern, und fordert und befähigt beide Seiten. Du bist in diesen Runden dabei, siehst, wie Prioritäten gesetzt und auf die Probe gestellt werden, und bildest dir dein eigenes Urteil darüber, was das Geschäft wirklich bewegt.
Übernimm die Sonderprojekte end to end. Ein großer Teil der Arbeit ist Zero to One und passt noch in keine saubere Stellenbeschreibung, vom Aufbau des B2B-Angebots bis zu unseren PR- und Comms-Strukturen. Die Liste ändert sich ständig, und du bringst Themen von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung.
Arbeite im Startup-Tempo. Vieles passiert ad hoc, Entscheidungen fallen schnell, und wir erwarten eine Get-things-done-Mentalität. Du bringst Struktur rein, schließt die Lücken und wartest nicht, bis man dir sagt, was zu tun ist.


Das bringst du mit
column5: >Du bist Generalist und denkst in Ownership.
column6:
> Du siehst die Lücke und schließt sie. Du bringst Ordnung in unübersichtliche Probleme, ohne dass man dich darum bittet, und bist am stärksten, wenn der Weg noch nicht vorgezeichnet ist.
Du hast schon auf Top-Niveau geliefert. Frisch von einer Top-Universität, mit einem Track Record bei einer führenden Beratung oder einem Top-Tier-Startup. Du arbeitest über deinem Level, und das kannst du belegen.
Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch. Du wechselst mühelos zwischen deutschsprachiger Partner- und Kandidatenkommunikation und einem englischsprachigen Team.
Du willst eine Karriere, keinen Sommerjob. Das ist ein sechsmonatiges Vollzeit-Praktikum, und wenn du herausragend bist, wollen wir dich halten. Komm mit dem Gedanken rein, wohin das führt, nicht wo es endet.

Bei VREY bauen wir das EnergyOS für Mehrfamilienhäuser.

In Deutschland stehen über 3,3 Millionen Mehrparteienhäuser – und sie sind das schwarze Loch der Energiewende. <
column3:
2% Smart Metering. Kaum Flexibilität oder intelligentes Energiemanagement.

Gleichzeitig zwingt die Regulierung Eigentümer zu massiven Investitionen: Solar wird zur Pflicht, Smart Meter müssen in den nächsten 5 Jahren flächendeckend ausgerollt werden, Heizung und Mobilität elektrifizieren sich. Das Mehrfamilienhaus wird vom Betongold zum aktiven Teil der dezentralen Energieinfrastruktur.

Was fehlt, ist ein integriertes System, das diesen Wandel wirtschaftlich und operativ beherrschbar macht.

VREY kombiniert zertifizierten Messstellenbetrieb mit eigener Software und ermöglicht Eigentümern erstmals, ihren selbst erzeugten Solarstrom direkt an ihre Mieter zu verkaufen – einfach und ohne selbst zum Energieversorger zu werden (§42b EnWG).

Damit wird regulatorischer Zwang zu einer profitablen und planbaren Chance:

  • Zweistellige Renditen und Wertsteigerung für Eigentümer,

  • ~20 % Stromkostenersparnis für Mieter, und

  • digitale Infrastruktur für Speicher, Wärmepumpen und Flexibilität.

Bereits heute betreuen wir eine dreistellige Anzahl an Projekten - darunter die größten Bestandshalter und Wohnungsbaugenossenschaften - in allen 16 Bundesländern. Damit gehören wir nach kürzester Zeit zu den führenden Anbietern im Markt.

Im Zuge unserer Seed-Finanzierung haben wir 3,3 Mio. € von führenden Impact- und Energy-VCs (u. a. Rubio Impact Ventures, HTGF, Kopa Ventures) eingesammelt. Mit dem frischen Kapital gehen wir in die nächste Wachstumsphase und bauen unser Team gezielt aus.

Wir stehen am Anfang eines strukturellen Marktumbruchs. Wer heute die Energieinfrastruktur im Mehrfamilienhaus definiert, prägt sie für Jahrzehnte. Werde Teil von VREY und baue mit uns das führende EnergyOS.

senior-performance-marketing-manager-paid-social-meta-tiktok-remote-330304,Evolve Digital GmbH,Senior Performance Marketing Manager Paid Social – Meta & TikTok (m/w/d) · Remote,"

Das ist dein Job bei uns

Mittwochmorgen. Du öffnest den Business Manager und siehst zwei neue Hooks laufen, deutlich über Benchmark.

Du erhöhst direkt die Budgets. Anschließend briefst du Anna, unsere Creative Strategistin, auf die Iteration der Best Performer.

Anna baut mit Alex, Mona und Tobi aus dem Creative Team ein neues Set. UGC, Founder Ads und mehrere Statics. Wenige Tage später gehen sie live.

Am Donnerstag präsentierst du dem Kunden die Entwicklung der Performance und die nächsten Schritte. Dazu deine Vorschläge für den nächsten Produktlaunch. Rabatte allein reichen dir nicht. Jede Bestellung muss einen positiven Deckungsbeitrag tragen.

Danach briefst du dein Team. Jeder Schritt der Kampagne ist klar verteilt. Am Launchtag knackst du für den Kunden 50.000 € Ad Spend an einem Tag, profitabel.
column2:
>

Genau das ist dein Job.
column3:
>

Wofür wir arbeiten

Wir wollen der stärkste ganzheitliche Wachstumspartner für E-Commerce-Brands im DACH-Raum sein.

Denn was wir immer wieder sehen: Agenturen und Dienstleister betreuen Brands nischig und siloartig, Kanal für Kanal, ohne Blick aufs Ganze. Dabei bleiben enorme Potenziale auf der Strecke.

Wir verstehen uns deshalb nicht als Dienstleister, sondern als Teil des Unternehmens unserer Kunden. Dafür arbeiten bei EVOLVE 30 Spezialisten in sechs Fachbereichen zusammen, vollständig remote und seit dem ersten Tag.
column4:
>

Wir denken Paid Social anders

Dass das Creative über die Performance entscheidet, ist kein Geheimnis mehr. Das ist Standard. Wir setzen zudem eine Ebene höher an und entwickeln conversionstarke Angebote und Funnel mit. Denn ein starker ROAS entsteht selten nur aus guten Ads. Er entsteht aus dem Angebot dahinter:

  • Angebotslogik und Preisstruktur gehören für uns zum Kanal. Jedes Angebot rechnen wir auf Deckungsbeitrag durch, bevor es live geht.

  • Landingpages und Funnels bauen wir mit. Ein Creative verkauft nur so gut wie die Seite dahinter.

  • Creative Strategist, Copywriter, Grafiker und Videografen im eigenen Haus. Kein Warten auf externe Zulieferer, dazu ein AI-Stack für mehr Output.
column5:
>

Genau dafür suchen wir jemanden.
column6:
>

Was dich hier erwartet

Du übernimmst nicht ein paar Werbekonten. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für das Wachstum deiner Kunden über Social Ads und entwickelst eigenständig die richtige Strategie.

Denn wir arbeiten nicht mit Kunden zusammen, um Kampagnen zu verwalten. Wir arbeiten mit ihnen, um sie zum Wachsen zu bringen.
column7:
>

Was das im Alltag heißt:

  • Du planst und steuerst die Paid-Social-Kampagnen auf Meta und TikTok, von der Strategie bis zur täglichen Optimierung

  • Du skalierst Accounts auf hohe fünf- bis sechsstellige Monatsbudgets. Die Zielmetrik ist Profitabilität, nicht Ad Spend.

  • Du entwickelst die Creative-Konzepte mit Anna und dem Creative Team. UGC, Founder Ads und Statics entstehen aus Testdaten, nicht aus Bauchgefühl.

  • Du lieferst die Ideen für Ads und Funnels nach Direct-Response-Prinzipien. Unser Team setzt sie um und arbeitet sie im Detail aus.

  • Du sorgst dafür, dass Hooks, Formate und Narrative laufend getestet werden. Ein Gewinner-Creative hält auf hohen Ad-Spend-Leveln nicht lange.

  • Du führst die wöchentlichen Kundenreportings und berätst auf Entscheiderebene, nicht nur zum Kanal

  • Du baust den Social Ads Bereich weiter aus, über SOPs, Qualitätsmanagement und die fachliche Führung neuer Teammitglieder
column8:
>

Der letzte Punkt ist uns wichtig. Diese Rolle gibt es bei EVOLVE einmal. Deshalb suchen wir jemanden, der die Verantwortung für das gesamte Paid Social Team übernehmen will und sich perspektivisch als Paid Social Lead entwickelt.
column9:
>

Das solltest du mitbringen

  • Mindestens drei Jahre Erfahrung im Performance Marketing mit Schwerpunkt Paid Social, als Hauptkanal und nicht nebenbei

  • Nachweisbare Skalierung von E-Commerce-Accounts auf hohe fünf- bis sechsstellige Monatsbudgets

  • Tiefes Wissen im Meta Business Manager, idealerweise auch im TikTok Ads Manager. Dazu Routine mit Tracking-Tools wie Triple Whale, Admetrics oder Tracify

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Margen, Deckungsbeiträgen, CAC und POAS. Ohne diese Zahlen lässt sich profitabel nicht skalieren

  • Strategisches Verständnis für E-Commerce. Du denkst über den Werbekanal hinaus und steuerst Projekte entlang des gesamten Kundengeschäfts

  • Verständnis für Direct-Response-Mechanismen, UGC-Formate und Founder Ads. Du erkennst, warum ein Creative verkauft, und nicht nur, dass es verkauft

  • Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau für Kundenkommunikation und Copy-Bewertung. Englisch fließend für die Arbeit in den Ad-Managern

  • Sehr gute Selbstorganisation, auch weil wir 100 % remote arbeiten

  • Idealerweise erste Erfahrung in fachlicher Führung oder im Mentoring von Junioren
column10:
>

Direkt gesagt: Dieser Job passt nicht zu jedem

Du solltest dich nicht bewerben, wenn du keine E-Commerce-Erfahrung mitbringst. Wir suchen jemanden, der Accounts auf exzellentem Niveau steuert. Fachlich challengen wir dich gern. Das E-Commerce-Know-how solltest du jedoch schon mitbringen.
column11:
>

Der Rahmen

  • 100 % Remote seit Tag 1, kein Hybrid-Kompromiss

  • 30 Tage Urlaub

  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Jobrad und Firmenfitness über Wellpass

  • Laptop deiner Wahl und hochwertige Homeoffice-Ausstattung

  • Weiterbildungsbudget sowie Unterstützung durch interne und externe Quellen und Mentoren an deiner Seite

  • Voller Zugriff auf unseren internen AI-Stack

  • Zweimal jährlich Teamevents und Workations
column12:
>

So läuft der Prozess

Deine Bewerbung. Dein Lebenslauf reicht. Wenn wir Rückfragen haben, schicken wir dir einen kurzen Fragebogen.

Erstgespräch. Ein kurzes Video-Gespräch mit Vanessa aus unserem HR: gegenseitiges Kennenlernen, Rahmen und Erwartungen.

Fachgespräch. Hier geht es in die Tiefe, mit der Geschäftsführung oder dem Lead deines Fachbereichs.

Finales Kennenlernen. Mit der Geschäftsführung und deinem zukünftigen Ansprechpartner, persönlich und fachlich. Hier definieren wir deine Stelle noch einmal genau auf Basis deiner Stärken und Interessen.

Entscheidung und Start. Wir entscheiden schnell und planen dein Onboarding gemeinsam.
column13:
>

Deine Entwicklung bei uns

About the Company

Our client is an international manufacturer of urban infrastructure and public environment solutions with a strong presence across Northern Europe. Following a recent strategic acquisition, Germany has become one of the company's key growth markets, with ambitious plans to significantly expand its commercial footprint over the coming years.
As Sales Director / Business Development Director, you will take ownership of the German business, leading its commercial strategy and driving long-term growth. Initially, your focus will be on a portfolio of public transport shelters, bicycle shelters, and related infrastructure solutions, with the opportunity to expand into a broader range of urban furniture and smart city products as the business grows.

This is a unique opportunity for an entrepreneurial commercial leader who enjoys building businesses, developing markets, and creating lasting customer relationships.

What you will do

  • Develop and professionalize the sales organization and commercial processes for the German market.
  • Define and execute a scalable sales strategy to drive sustainable revenue growth.
  • Identify new business opportunities, customer segments, and strategic growth initiatives.
  • Build long-term partnerships with municipalities, public sector organizations, transport authorities, contractors, architects, planners, and other infrastructure stakeholders.
  • Lead complex project-based sales processes, including public tenders and consultative solution selling.
  • Recruit, develop, and expand the local sales organization over time.
  • Strengthen the company's market position and brand awareness across Germany.
  • Work closely with international teams across marketing, product development, sourcing, and operations to support business growth.
  • Establish a structured sales pipeline and implement a CRM-driven sales process to support scalable growth.

What you bring

  • Proven experience in B2B sales and business development within the German market.
  • Track record of building and growing successful sales organizations.
  • Experience within construction, infrastructure, urban furniture, public environment solutions, or comparable industries.
  • Strong leadership skills with experience recruiting, coaching, and developing commercial teams.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a hands-on approach and the ability to thrive in a growing business.
  • Experience managing long sales cycles, tender-driven sales, and consultative solution selling.
  • Existing network within municipalities, infrastructure, construction, architecture, or related industries is a strong advantage.
  • Fluent German and English communication skills.

Why join?

Lead the growth of an established business with significant market potential.

Enjoy a high level of autonomy and ownership while shaping the commercial strategy for Germany.

Represent an established portfolio of high-quality infrastructure solutions with strong references across Europe.

Join an entrepreneurial, international organization with long-term growth ambitions.

Play a key role in building both the business and the future local sales team.

Work in close collaboration with experienced international colleagues while making a direct impact on one of the company's most strategic markets.

KAYAK, part of Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG), is a leading travel search engine. With billions of queries across our platforms, we help people find their perfect flight, stay, rental car and vacation package. We're also transforming business travel with a new corporate travel solution, KAYAK for Business.

As an employee of KAYAK, you will be part of a travel company that operates a portfolio of global metasearch brands including momondo, Cheapflights and HotelsCombined, among others. From start-up to industry leader, innovation is in our DNA and every employee has an opportunity to make their mark. Our focus is on building the best travel search engine to make it easier for everyone to experience the world.

Every machine learning model KAYAK ships depends on reliable, scalable infrastructure to move from experiment to production — and that's exactly what this role makes possible. KAYAK is seeking a Senior MLOps Engineer who will focus on the design and implementation of our machine learning infrastructure and production lifecycle. This is a senior, hands-on role where you will bridge the gap between data science and production engineering.

You will join the Machine Learning Platform team and be responsible for building and maintaining scalable infrastructure &
column2:
automated pipelines for model training, deployment, and monitoring, ensuring our ML models are reliable, reproducible, and performant. You will work closely with Data Scientists, ML Engineering and Operations teams to transform experimental code into robust, production-ready services at scale.

This role requires commuting to the Berlin office 3 times a week.

In this role, you will:

  • Build and maintain ML infrastructure end-to-end: Extend and operate the infrastructure that powers every model we ship — including CI/CD pipelines, model orchestration, and automated training pipelines designed to scale reliably without manual intervention.

  • Own model deployment and serving: Help define and evolve the standards and tooling for model serving, ensuring low latency and high availability across our ML services.

  • Develop core MLOps capabilities: Establish and maintain essential infrastructure that functions as reliable, self-service systems for the entire machine learning organization — with a focus on feature stores, model registries, and automated monitoring for performance and data drift.

  • Operationalize infrastructure for the ML team: Collaborate with Operations to enable Kubernetes (k8s) autoscaling and GPU provisioning, turning these into accessible, self-service tools for ML practitioners — including standing up and operating a Kubernetes-based development cluster and taking models from experimentation to GPU-backed production.

  • Improve platform reliability and performance: Partner with Operations to design resilient monitoring using advanced observability tooling. Define service-level objectives and implement automation to reduce manual interventions and improve system reliability.

  • Empower Data Scientists through standardized, optimized workflows: Amplify the impact of the ML team by building clear, well-supported ""golden paths"" — standardized workflows that streamline the model development lifecycle and let Data Scientists focus on modeling while you handle the infrastructure.

Please apply if you have:

  • Experience building and operating ML platforms in production environments.

  • Solid working knowledge of containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes), Linux internals, and model serving at scale.

  • Familiarity with ML lifecycle tooling, including orchestration frameworks, feature stores, model registries, and drift or performance monitoring.

  • Experience owning production systems: defining service-level objectives (SLOs), building observability (for example, using tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, or Datadog), participating in incident response, and diagnosing large-scale failures systematically. You look for opportunities to automate repetitive work rather than absorb it.

  • Comfort writing production-quality code in Python or a comparable language.

  • The ability to take ownership of technical outcomes, advocate for decisions using data, and communicate clearly in writing and in person — to both technical and non-technical audiences.

bunch is building the backbone of private markets. We are enabling next-gen fund operations with one integrated system that combines secure data infrastructure, AI-powered workflows and expert fund services. If you value ownership, growth through real responsibility, and working with a thoughtful, ambitious team, this role might be for you.

Your Role

As Head of Sales at bunch, you will strengthen, lead and scale our sales team across key European markets — UK, Luxembourg and Germany. Reporting directly to the Co-Founder, you will turn our high-touch executive commercial motion into a structured, repeatable sales engine across our key European markets.

You will lead Account Executives and Commercial Associates selling to sophisticated decision-makers across VC, PE, and alternative asset managers (GPs, CFOs, COOs, and Fund Ops teams). Because our business model combines scalable SaaS capabilities with high-touch fund services, sales cycles are relationship-driven, multi-stakeholder, and often long. This role demands a leader who can combine structured organisation and process building, relentless deal execution and strong coaching with domain adaptability.

You will:

  • Lead, coach, and develop Account Executives across UK, Luxembourg and Germany.

  • Set a high bar for sales quality, customer understanding, pipeline discipline, commercial judgment, and performance

  • Define and execute market-by-market sales plans in close partnership with the leadership team

  • Build a predictable sales operating cadence across pipeline reviews, forecasting, deal inspection, CRM discipline, and conversion tracking

  • Set up scalable sales processes across the full funnel — from lead routing, qualification, discovery, mutual action plans, pricing, proposal creation, negotiation, handover, and post-sale feedback loops

  • Own the commercial operating system: CRM hygiene, reporting, dashboarding, pipeline definitions, stage exit criteria, forecasting methodology, activity tracking, and tooling adoption

  • Create and maintain sales handbooks, enablement materials, talk tracks, qualification guides, objection-handling resources, market playbooks, and deal review templates so the team has a clear source of truth

  • Coach the team on complex enterprise sales: discovery, qualification, stakeholder mapping, business-case building, negotiation, pricing, executive communication, and multi-threading

  • Build a regular coaching rhythm through call reviews, deal reviews, pipeline inspection, 1:1s, performance feedback, and structured development plans

  • Stay close to strategic deals where customer trust, market context, executive engagement, or commercial judgment are critical

  • Partner closely with other teams, including Marketing, Customer Success, Product Development, Operations, Legal &
column2:

    • About you

    • You have proven experience navigating commercial models that blend scalable software/SaaS with high-touch services, implementation, or customer operations, understanding how to price, position, and transition complex deals without eroding margins.

    • Extensive B2B commercial experience with proven success closing complex, consultative enterprise software or tech-enabled service deals.

    • Direct experience selling into venture capital, private equity, asset management, or fund services is a strong plus, but your ability to build a high-performing tech sales motion comes first.

    • You have a track record of driving sales motions for high-ticket solutions where deal sizes are consistently in the hundreds of thousands, focusing on relationship-driven, consultative outcomes.

    • You have 3+ years of experience directly managing, coaching, and scaling Account Executives teams, with a clear track record of raising team performance, enforcing pipeline discipline, and driving revenue growth.

    • You have coached team members through long-cycle, multi-stakeholder enterprise deals

    • You have successfully built and scaled sales motions across multiple markets, driving high performance through rigorous CRM discipline, RevOps tooling, and predictable forecasting routines.

    • You excel at creating practical sales handbooks, enablement resources, playbooks, and coaching frameworks that teams rely on to drive complex, long-cycle enterprise deals.

    • You are a seasoned people leader who sets a high bar for excellence, fostering talent through direct feedback, clear performance management, and structured coaching.

    • You combine strong commercial judgment—knowing when to push or qualify out—with the executive presence to build trust and credibility with senior stakeholders.

    • You have a builder mentality and are comfortable creating structure in an environment that is still scaling

    • You communicate excellently in English

    Existing understanding of VC / PE fund operations, GP / LP structures, fund administration, investor onboarding, transfer agency, or Luxembourg fund structures is a strong plus.

    What success looks like

    In your first months, you will build a clear understanding of bunch’s commercial motion, ICP, product, implementation model, pricing, and market dynamics. You will establish trust with the existing sales team, founders, and key cross-functional partners, while introducing a clear cadence for pipeline reviews, deal coaching, forecasting, and performance visibility.

    Over time, you will strengthen the team’s execution across priority markets, improve pipeline quality and forecast accuracy, standardise the sales playbook, support hiring and onboarding, and build stronger cross-functional routines with Marketing, Solutions, Operations, Customer Success, Product, and RevOps. You will also establish the core sales infrastructure the team needs to scale: clear funnel processes, reliable CRM workflows, useful dashboards, practical handbooks, repeatable coaching routines, and a shared source of truth for how we sell.

    Ultimately, you will help build a high-performing and scalable sales organisation across UK, Luxembourg and Germany, improving predictable revenue generation and constantly raising the quality bar for complex private-markets selling.
