embedded-linux-software-engineer-maritime-n3xt-gilching-104667,Quantum-Systems GmbH,Embedded Linux Software Engineer (m/f/d) - Maritime N3XT,"

As an embedded Linux software engineer in the NEXT Maritime department you will develop software for our sea drones for control, navigation, mission specific tasks and evaluation of operation.

Together with our small but mixed team of mechanical, electrical and software engineers you will develop world-class products that will shape the future of naval technology.

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Engange into design decisions for new technical solutions and bring in the embedded software point of view

  • Implement, maintain and optimize software for autopilots, communication, navigation, payload specific processes

  • Integrate new sensors, cameras etc. into an existing hardware and software environment, aligning with suppliers and other teams

  • Test and evaluate new integrations in field tests

  • Support your colleagues with software specific tasks: log evaluation, tool development etc.




What you bring to the team:

  • 3+ years of experience in Linux software development, preferably in embedded or robotics systems

  • Strong proficiency in C/C++ (14 or newer) with proven experience developing Linux applications

  • Understanding of Linux internals, including system services, device trees, and kernel modules

  • Experience with cross-compilation, Yocto, Buildroot, or similar build systems

  • Hands-on experience with debugging tools (e.g., GDB, strace, perf) and log analysis

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, version control systems (e.g., Git), and release management

  • Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to debug both software and hardware integration issues

  • Proficiency in technical documentation, including interface definitions and architectural decisions

  • You are highly self-motivated and drive your area of responsibility independently

  • You are open and curious towards new technologies and method.

  • Due to your open, communicative, friendly, and competent attitude, it is easy for you to be considered as an internal expert

  • Communication in English is a matter of course for you.


Why Quantum-Systems:

  • We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus.

  • We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary.

  • We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data.

  • We promise to be your runway for individual and professional growth.


Our benefits:

  • Company pension scheme: We support you so that you can already make provisions for later.

  • Flexible working hours: With trust-based working hours, you are not only responsible for your working hours, but also for your work-life balance.

  • Mobile Work: If things get a little busy in the office, you have the option to work remotely one flexible day per week to create the right balance.

  • Stay active: With EGYM Wellpass, you get access to thousands of fitness and sports facilities — and of course, we subsidize the membership.

  • Bike-Leasing: We support you in staying environmentally mobile and healthy.

  • Corporate Benefits: Your opportunity for attractive offers and discounts from well-known suppliers and brands, e.g. Adidas, Apple, Expedia.

  • Employee events: We not only want to grow together, but also celebrate our successes together.

  • Lunch-Card: Be powerful with delicious energy, daily lunch budget is sponsored.

  • Company Shuttle: Enjoy our convenient shuttle service that picks you up from Pasing in Munich and brings you to our location, with return trips at the end of the workday.

By integrating cutting-edge software capabilities, like edge computing and real-time AI-powered data processing, Quantum Systems is building next-generation UAS for clients in defence, security, public sectors.

We're Redis. We built the product that runs the fast apps our world runs on. (If you checked the weather, used your credit card, or looked at your flight status online today, you’re welcome.) The Team

Document-oriented workloads are at the heart of many modern applications, and in this role you’ll help shape how developers build them using Redis. You will own and evolve Redis’s document data capabilities, enabling developers to work with JSON-based application data in a fast, intuitive, and scalable way across a wide range of real-world use cases.

You’ll work on a highly visible and deeply technical product area, collaborating closely with experienced engineers, architects, and customer-facing teams. The challenges you’ll tackle span data modelling, performance, memory efficiency, scalability, and developer experience, with direct feedback from customers running document-centric workloads at scale.

This role offers a unique opportunity to influence how Redis is used beyond caching, while balancing simplicity and flexibility with the needs of open source users and enterprise customers in cloud and self-managed environments. Our goal is to have a solar system on every roof, a storage unit in every house, and an electric car in every garage. Enpal makes this possible with an integrated total solution for decentralized energy—from solar systems and battery storage to wall boxes, smart meters, and heat pumps. At the heart of it all is our AI-powered platform Enpal.One+, which intelligently connects thousands of systems and efficiently optimizes electricity procurement and feed-in on the energy market.

Enpal Energy is Enpal’s electricity division, making clean energy accessible to every household—from Germany’s most affordable electricity rates to smart energy solutions that optimally integrate generation, storage, and consumption.

With ambitious growth targets and a rapidly expanding customer base, we are building a team that is actively shaping the German energy market. REPLUG is a Mobile Revenue Growth partner that helps companies turn mobile into a measurable driver of revenue, customer value, and long-term business growth.
Rather than treating acquisition, retention, measurement and app experience as separate disciplines, we help businesses connect them into a unified growth system that improves commercial performance.

From global app publishers to established brands looking to unlock more value from mobile, we partner with companies that want to grow more efficiently, reduce dependency on saturated acquisition channels and build sustainable growth.
Our work combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution across App Store Optimization, Paid User Acquisition, CRM, measurement and mobile growth consulting.
We're now looking for a Strategic Supply Partnership Lead to grow our performance ads business globally.
We’re looking for a Strategic Partnerships Lead to own and develop REPLUG’s performance supply ecosystem.
This is not a traditional account management role, and we are not looking for someone whose experience is limited to managing an existing book of supply partners.
We want someone with a genuine hunter mentality.
You should have a proven track record of identifying, approaching, and onboarding new partners, opening doors through your own network, and creating new commercial opportunities from scratch.

Strong industry relationships matter in this role. We are looking for someone who already understands the key players across the mobile performance ecosystem, knows who is worth speaking to, and can use that network to accelerate REPLUG’s access to new supply.

Just as importantly, you should have strong market intelligence. You should know what is happening across the ecosystem, where new inventory is emerging, which partners are gaining traction, where quality is deteriorating, and where the next meaningful opportunities may come from.

You’ll be responsible for identifying the partners we should work with, building the commercial relationships behind them, negotiating the right conditions and ensuring that those partnerships translate into real growth opportunities for our clients and REPLUG.
You’ll operate at the intersection of partnerships, commercial strategy and performance operations.
Your ecosystem will span OEMs, DSPs, SDK networks, publishers, affiliate partners and other alternative acquisition channels.
You’ll work closely with our performance, operations and sales teams to ensure we have the right supply available to support client growth.
You will report directly to the Performance Ads Lead, while working alongside the founders.
You’ll continuously develop the network of partners that powers REPLUG’s alternative acquisition offering.
• Identify and evaluate new publishers, networks and inventory partners globally.
• Develop relationships with OEMs, DSPs, SDK networks, affiliates and other performance partners.
• Own partner onboarding from initial evaluation through activation.
• Identify gaps in our current supply and proactively develop new opportunities.
• Build a diversified ecosystem that allows us to scale without becoming overly dependent on individual partners.
Our goal is to build the right ecosystem to scale brands globally.
You’ll manage our supply relationships as commercial partnerships, not simply operational integrations.
• Negotiating payouts, pricing models and commercial terms.
• Identifying opportunities to improve margins and scalability.
• Exploring exclusive opportunities, preferred access or new inventory.
• Holding partners accountable for agreed performance, quality and delivery.
• Understanding when a partnership should be scaled, renegotiated or stopped.
You should be comfortable protecting REPLUG’s commercial interests while maintaining strong long-term relationships.
Supply has value only when it delivers results.
You’ll work closely with our internal teams to:
• Match client campaigns with the most relevant inventory and partners.
• Identify new scaling opportunities based on campaign performance.
• Analyse partner performance across quality, delivery, scalability and economics.
• Identify supply-side issues that may be limiting campaign performance.
• Help teams diversify acquisition when existing channels begin to saturate.
You’ll need to understand both sides of the equation: what advertisers need and what partners can realistically deliver.
You’ll help ensure that REPLUG’s supply ecosystem maintains a high standard of performance and transparency.
When something doesn’t make sense, we expect you to investigate it rather than accept the explanation you’re given.
The role also extends beyond third-party partnerships.
You’ll contribute to the development of REPLUG’s own performance ecosystem, including:
• Managing and optimizing supply operations for our in-house rewarded app ecosystem.
• Supporting the development of our internal affiliate and network marketplace infrastructure.
• Identifying opportunities to build more direct supply relationships.
• Helping define processes, systems and commercial frameworks that make the ecosystem scalable.
This gives you the opportunity to help build infrastructure rather than simply manage existing relationships.
We’re looking for someone who understands that successful partnerships sit somewhere between relationships, numbers and execution.
• At least 3-5 years of experience within mobile advertising, AdTech, performance marketing, or affiliate marketing.
• A solid understanding of the mobile performance ecosystem.
• Experience working with publishers, networks, DSPs, OEMs, affiliates, SDK traffic or comparable acquisition partners.
• Strong commercial instincts and confidence negotiating deals.
• The ability to evaluate a partnership based on performance and business potential, not just relationship quality.
• Strong analytical thinking and comfort working with performance data and KPIs.
• The ability to manage multiple partners and initiatives simultaneously.
• A proactive approach to identifying problems and opportunities.
• Existing relationships across the mobile advertising ecosystem.
• Experience managing international publisher or supply partnerships.
• Experience with rewarded acquisition or offerwall ecosystems.
• Understanding of attribution, MMPs and mobile measurement.
• Experience working with performance campaigns on CPI, CPA, ROAS or revenue-based models.
• Previous experience within a mobile agency, ad network, DSP, affiliate network or app growth company.
• Understands when to push and when a partnership simply isn’t worth pursuing.
• Wants to build systems and relationships rather than inherit a static portfolio.
Joining REPLUG means you'll have the opportunity to:
• Lead the supply partnership strategy for ambitious mobile brands.
• Work alongside mobile growth specialists, driving growth across the whole mobile ecosystem
• Help shape one of the industry's emerging Mobile Revenue Growth consultancies.
• Own and influence how we scale our performance ads business
• Become one of the public faces of REPLUG through conferences, webinars and industry content.
• Work remotely with flexibility and a high level of ownership.
• Continue developing through learning, experimentation and industry events.

Founders Factory builds and funds startups together with exceptional entrepreneurs and the world's leading companies. About the Venture

Every hospital in Europe loses millions to a manual, error-prone coding process that hasn't changed in decades. When a patient is discharged, a trained specialist reads 20–50 pages of clinical documentation and manually translates every diagnosis and procedure into standardised codes. These codes determine how much the hospital gets paid.

In Germany, 17.5 million inpatient cases per year require manual coding. 51.5% of audited cases contain errors. €2.5–3 billion is clawed back annually by insurers through MD audits. 75% of German hospitals ended 2024 in deficit. The coder workforce — several thousand Kodierfachkräfte, each requiring 6–12 months of training at ~€42K salary — cannot scale fast enough.

We are building an autonomous AI coding agent that reads everything the coder reads, reasons from the official coding guidelines (Deutsche Kodierrichtlinien), and enters codes into existing hospital software — in seconds, not 35 minutes. Unlike traditional ML approaches that learn from historical patterns (and inherit their errors), our architecture reasons from the rules at inference time: when InEK publishes annual updates, we swap the guideline document. No retraining. No training data needed. Every code comes with an evidence chain and DKR citation — audit-ready by construction.

The deployment model is equally differentiated: computer-use agents navigate any hospital information system (KIS) via VPN, exactly as a human coder would. No API integration. No IT burden on the hospital. Deployment in days, not months. Deep EHR integration follows as relationships deepen, creating switching costs.

The AI clinical coding market is ~$3B today, projected to reach $10–11B by 2035. In Germany, the addressable market is €150–400M for AI coding software alone, with an additional ~€1.6B/year in audit clawbacks that better coding recovers. US players (CodaMetrix, Fathom, Nym) have raised $600M+ but are built for American codes and EHRs. Parallel has proven the model in France ($23.5M raised, computer-use approach validated) but hasn't entered Germany. The German G-DRG system is wide open.

  • Build and maintain end-to-end pipelines in the Azure stack, ingesting source data into the Data Lake and Azure SQL, orchestrated with Azure Data Factory.

Unsere Plattform ist von Tag eins an agentisch gedacht. Bevor wir überhaupt die UI geplant haben, haben wir geplant, wie Agenten mit der Software arbeiten. Denk dran – unser Ziel ist, die ganze Branche zu automatisieren, und das meinen wir ernst.

About the role

Passionfroot exists to empower creators to go after their passion - to turn what they love into a real business.

Today, we work with thousands of creators: LinkedIn thought leaders, YouTube educators, newsletter writers, podcast hosts, and a new generation of B2B creators who are reshaping how companies reach their audiences. Our creator community includes some of the most influential voices in business, technology, and education, including creators such as Elena Verna, Marina Mogilko, and Zain Kahn.

As our Creator Partnership Manager, your job is to find and onboard the best creators for the best B2B tech brands in the world. You'll build the sourcing pipeline, run a great onboarding experience, and turn what works into repeatable systems so we can keep scaling creator supply as the company grows.

You'll work closely with growth, ops, and the campaign team, with plenty of room to shape how this function runs day to day.

Find great creators

Onboard them brilliantly

Build scalable systems

Why this role matters

About Passionfroot

Creator-led growth is one of the fastest-growing channels in B2B—and we’re building the infrastructure behind it.

Passionfroot is the leading platform where modern companies scale creator-led growth, and where top creators manage and monetize brand partnerships.

Our customers include some of the most ambitious, fastest-moving companies in the world—Replit, HubSpot, Figma, Cursor, Gamma, Attio, Intercom, and ElevenLabs. We help them run high-impact creator programs across LinkedIn, YouTube, newsletters, and more.

We're growing 13x in revenue year over year, profitable, and just closed our Series A round! We are backed by leading investors including Insight Partners, Creandum, Supernode and founders and operators from Cursor, Anthropic, n8n and more. We're expanding fast across New York, Europe, and Brazil - and we're just getting started.

We’re still a small team, which means the people who join now will have an outsized influence on the product, the engineering culture, and the company we become.

About the role

We’re looking for a Senior or Staff Product Engineer to help build the next generation of Passionfroot.

You’ll work across the full stack on both our core platform and Zest, our AI Campaign Manager for creator marketing. That could mean designing a new workflow for managing creator campaigns, making collaboration data feel instant, or turning models, search, and product context into a reliable AI experience that customers can trust.

We don’t separate “AI engineering” from “product engineering.” AI is becoming part of how the product works, but great product fundamentals still matter: understanding the user, shaping the problem, choosing the right architecture, building a thoughtful experience, and operating it reliably in production.

You’ll work closely with the founders, design, and customers to take important problems from early exploration to shipped product.

We’re a team of six engineers, and staying small is deliberate. It means you can have an idea on Monday and have customers using it by Thursday—without layers of sprint ceremonies or alignment meetings in between. The flip side is real ownership: you need to exercise strong judgment, communicate your decisions, and think through their consequences rather than wait for someone else to catch them.

What you’ll do

  • Own meaningful product areas from problem definition through architecture, implementation, launch, and iteration.

  • Build customer-facing features across our marketplace, campaign management, collaboration, payments, analytics, and creator workflows.

  • Help make Zest an indispensable part of how modern companies run creator-led growth.

  • Turn foundation models into structured, reliable product experiences—not just impressive prototypes.

  • Work on intelligent workflows involving agents, tools, retrieval, search, recommendations, and generated interfaces.

  • Develop the evaluations, observability, and feedback loops needed to understand whether AI features are genuinely useful.

  • Work closely with design to create experiences that are fast, intuitive, and polished.

  • Talk directly with customers and translate ambiguous needs into simple product decisions.

  • Make pragmatic architectural choices that balance speed, quality, maintainability, and performance.

  • Improve the systems and engineering practices that help a small team ship reliably at high velocity.

  • At Staff level, provide technical direction across projects, raise the engineering bar, and help other engineers make better decisions.

What we’re looking for

  • Significant experience building and shipping high-quality, customer-facing software. 5+ years is a useful guide, but the scope and quality of your work matter more than the number.

  • Strong TypeScript and React fundamentals, with experience working across the full stack.

  • A track record of independently driving complex features or products from an ambiguous starting point to measurable customer impact. When you encounter a blocker, you investigate, communicate, and find another path forward without waiting to be managed.

  • Strong product and technical judgment. You care about what should be built, how it should feel, and whether it actually solves the problem. You can distinguish between problems that need a sophisticated system and problems that need a simple, well-executed solution.

  • Experience building with LLMs or other applied AI systems in production.

  • An understanding of the challenges behind reliable AI products: evaluation, context, retrieval, model behavior, latency, cost, observability, and failure modes.

  • Clear, proactive communication and the ability to collaborate effectively in a remote environment.

  • Care for software craftsmanship without losing sight of momentum and customer outcomes.

Our technology

Passionfroot is built primarily in TypeScript across the full stack.

Our core product uses React, Remix, PostgreSQL, Prisma, and Zero sync for real-time product experiences. Our AI systems use foundation models from multiple providers alongside the AI SDK, Typesense, and Laminar for search, agent workflows, evaluations, and observability.

You don’t need experience with everything we use. We care more about strong fundamentals, relevant product experience, and your ability to learn quickly.

What success looks like

Within your first months, you will have:

  • Developed a deep understanding of creator-led growth and the problems our customers face.

  • Taken ownership of a major product or technical area with limited oversight.

  • Improved how we build, evaluate, and operate AI-powered functionality.

  • Earned the trust of the team through reliable execution and clear communication.

  • Helped us make better product and technical decisions beyond your immediate projects.

Our interview process

We want the process to be useful, respectful, and representative of how we actually work. We don’t use take-home challenges or algorithmic whiteboard interviews.

The process typically includes:

  1. A short introductory call.

  2. A conversation with Lorenzo about your experience, ambitions, and the work you are most proud of.

  3. A technical walkthrough of a project you know deeply, focused on the decisions and trade-offs you made.

  4. A collaborative product and technical problem-solving session with members of the team.

  5. A paid work trial based on a realistic problem, which can be completed flexibly around your current commitments.

  6. References and offer.

We aim to complete the process within one to two weeks.

What we offer

  • Competitive salary and equity in a Series A company.

  • Remote-first work with the option to work together in Berlin if you are local.

  • Latest Apple hardware and the tools you need to do your best work.

  • 25 days of paid vacation, plus local public holidays.

  • Regular team events and off-sites—past destinations include Mallorca, Barcelona, the South of France, Berlin, and the Baltic Sea.

Who We Are

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.

Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.

About the Role:

The Solutions Consultant Manager is the person who makes our GTM motion real on the ground. As an in-region leader directly managing a team of Solutions Consultants, you'll own your team's full commercial output—new logo, expansion, and renewals—and be accountable for both the results and the quality of execution that produces them.

This isn't a traditional pipeline-management role. The best SC Managers are coaches first: they know what a great first meeting looks like, can watch a live build and tell a rep exactly what to change, and build the operating rhythm and inspection cadence that makes consistent execution possible across the team. If you're a builder who loves developing people as much as winning deals—and you want to lead a regional team in a go-to-market model that's genuinely new—this is the role.

This role will be based in Munich, Germany. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.

What You'll Achieve:

  • Own the commercial performance of your team across new logo ARR, expansion ARR, and UBP outcomes—accountable for both the headline numbers and the quality of execution that drives them

  • Coach SCs on the GTM builder motion: what great looks like in a first meeting (workflow diagnosis, current → future architecture), a second meeting (live build in Notion + value narrative), and through the full cycle to adoption hand-off

  • Contribute to and participate in the regional operating cadence: weekly pipeline reviews, deal support sessions, call reviews against the motion quality rubric, and forecast calls with senior leadership

  • Hire, onboard, and certify new SCs to the GTM builder motion—driving readiness from ramp through consistent execution, and managing performance with clarity when expectations aren't met

  • Partner with the regional BDR manager on pipeline strategy, outbound targeting, and qualification standards to ensure the team's book of business is healthy and growing

  • Partner with Outcomes leadership on adoption hand-offs, at-risk account management, and renewal strategy—owning the overall commercial arc for the region while collaborating on the execution that follows close

  • Represent your team or region in leadership forums with clear signal on what's working, what needs investment, and where execution is breaking down

Skills You'll Need to Bring:

  • Track record as a quota-carrying B2B seller with direct experience in workflow design, live demos, or technical sales—you can coach the builder motion because you've run it yourself

  • Frontline sales management experience: built an operating cadence, ran performance management, and developed talent from onboarding through consistent overperformance

  • Strong coaching orientation: you can watch a demo or deal review and identify specifically what to change—not just whether the outcome was good, but why, and what the rep should do differently next time

  • Commercial instincts at the team level: able to read pipeline health, identify risk early, and drive urgency across a team without micromanaging individual deals

  • You don't need to be an AI expert, but you're curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.

  • Fluency in English and German.

Nice to Haves:

  • Experience selling or managing in a consumption or usage-based business where adoption signals matter as much as closed ARR

  • Track record building high-performing regional teams from an early stage: hiring to profile, structured onboarding, certification, and performance management

  • Experience in a shared account ownership model—able to navigate the SC/CSA hand-offs and hold the commercial arc across the full customer lifecycle

At Emidat, we are building the first climate-native product management system for building material manufacturers. We aim to decarbonise building materials, making up 11% of global GHG emissions. We collect data from physical production processes, generate a digital product passport with verified environmental data and make it usable along the value chain. In short: One solution to assess, design, buy, sell and manage products - with environmental impact at the core.

With this, we are building the digital infrastructure to make it faster, easier, and more sustainable to build the world around us.

You'll also work closely with our LCA Domain Experts, giving you exposure to the technical foundation of our product.

sr-talent-acquisition-partner-gtm-germany-374089,Vclusterlabs,Sr. Talent Acquisition Partner (GTM),"

As a Senior Talent Acquisition Partner, GTM at vCluster Labs, you aren't just filling open requisitions, you are the architect of our commercial team across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia Pacific. In this role, you will own recruiting for our sales, marketing, and customer facing functions, guiding candidates from the initial talent screen through offer. You will have the unique opportunity to build vCluster Labs' GTM bench across a wide and varied region, as one of the company's first TA hires on the ground in Europe.

As a Senior Talent Acquisition Partner, GTM, your role will include:

  • Full Cycle GTM Recruiting: Own the end to end hiring process for sales, marketing, and customer success roles across EMEA and APAC. You will guide candidates from the initial talent screen through offer, ensuring a seamless flow.

  • Regional GTM Expertise: Serve as our first EMEA based GTM recruiter and build the practices needed to hire commercial talent across a wide and varied region. You will stay closely aligned with the US based People Ops team while adapting to local market norms.

  • Strategic Sourcing: Proactively source and engage passive sales and marketing talent, with particular strength in identifying and closing senior Account Executives. You will build high quality pipelines so we are not relying solely on inbound applicants for critical commercial roles.

  • Data Driven Execution: Champion our structured interview process. You will ensure scorecards are used effectively to reduce bias, maintaining strict data integrity within our ATS, Ashby, to inform hiring decisions.

  • Candidate Experience: Drive an exceptional experience by ensuring transparent communication. You will treat candidates with customer centric speed, ensuring decisions are made in days, not months.

  • Partnership: Collaborate with GTM leaders to define the profile of a winning commercial hire in each market. You will act as a consultant on regional compensation, market trends, and closing strategy, not just an order taker.

This role could be a fit for you if you bring:

  • Experience: You have 5+ years of full cycle recruiting experience, specifically for GTM roles, within a high growth tech startup.

  • Regional Track Record: You have direct experience recruiting senior Account Executives and other commercial talent across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia Pacific, and you understand how hiring norms shift across those markets.

  • Location and Reach: You are based in Germany and ready to be one of vCluster Labs' first hires on the ground in Europe, working across EMEA, APAC, and US time zones as needed.

  • A Builder Mindset: You are comfortable operating in ambiguity and enjoy refining processes to make them more efficient, especially as you stand up new GTM hiring practices for the region.

  • A Data Centric Approach: You value results over tasks. You use data and analytics to track pipeline health and inform decision making.

  • High EQ and Active Listening: You are an effective communicator who genuinely listens to understand the perspectives of both candidates and hiring managers.

Bonus points for:

  • ATS Proficiency: Experience with Ashby.

  • Language Skills: Fluency in additional European languages beyond English or German.

  • Domain Expertise: Experience recruiting GTM talent for open source technology, developer tools, or infrastructure companies.

  • HR Generalist Background: Experience beyond recruiting, such as HR operations, employee relations, or onboarding, that gives you a broader view of the employee lifecycle.

About vCluster Labs

We are a venture-backed tech startup and the company pioneering Kubernetes virtualization for the AI era. We raised +$30M from top-tier VCs such as Khosla Ventures (first investor in OpenAI, GitLab, Stripe, Doordash) and are in a hyper-growth phase looking for motivated people to complement our team. Our headquarters are in San Francisco (Salesforce Tower), but our team is distributed around the globe and we have a remote-first work culture.

We are the leading platform for operating GPU infrastructure, enabling AI Cloud providers to deliver a hyperscaler-like experience to their customers and AI factories that need to build that same experience for their internal teams. Our platform delivers the full operational stack operators need to run their GPU data centers — managed Kubernetes, fast isolated tenant provisioning, and automated node provisioning and lifecycle management — enabling them to accelerate time to value, reduce operational burden, and maximize the ROI of every GPU.

We're the company behind vCluster, an open-source technology for virtualizing Kubernetes (10k+ GitHub stars, 40M+ virtual clusters created since 2021). Open source is part of our DNA. At KubeCon North America 2025, we launched our Infrastructure Tenancy Platform for AI — a Kubernetes-native framework purpose-built for running AI, ML, and GPU-intensive workloads anywhere, with an NVIDIA-validated reference architecture for DGX systems.

Benefits

We offer the following benefits:

  • Competitive Salary: We offer a competitive compensation package, including equity.

  • Platinum-Level Insurance: Health, dental, vision, and life Insurance, including plans for you and eligible dependents (benefits vary depending on country).

  • Flexible Working Schedule:  You have a doctor’s appointment or need to head to the supermarket to get groceries at 2pm? We won’t have an issue with that. To us, results matter more than clocking in and out at the same time every day.

  • Workplace Flexibility:  We’re very flexible about where you work. We know things can change in life and we’re happy to adjust the work environment for you along the way.

  2. Own the Outcome: We understand that our responsibility doesn't end when a task is checked off
